description: Prepare the exact approval/native value and increaseStakeAmount call while preserving the existing vote and fee accounting. Non-destructive: the vote is resized rather than cleared, no fees are discarded, and no NFT is burned. The added stake takes the NFT's existing lock end, so it cannot be withdrawn before that time.
